orient.intent: The scratch launch in cairn/devices/cc's class-verb proof asks MSYS bash for native symlinks, so the instance's superclaude link resolves to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py and both teeth hold on Windows.

constraints.text: Nothing is known until measured. An unmeasured claim is a hypothesis and is labeled as one.
Nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass.
Every component talks to every other only through its public interface: the proof reaches the launcher through bin/cairn.

sought: why test_superclaude_launches_over_a_scratch_box reds on Windows, by running the launch in a scratch box and reading the link it laid

absences.what: a scratch launch whose instance link is a symlink under MSYS bash
absences.measure: run the proof before the edit and read tooth 2 red (measured red 2026-11-24 on akiendell: the link is a copy, memory_link.py not found beside it)

sub_problems.what: D1: the proof's scratch env sets MSYS=winsymlinks:nativestrict so bash's ln -s lays a real symlink
sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-24 on akiendell: MSYS ln -s copied superclaude.py into the scratch bin; the copy looked for scripts/memory_link.py beside itself and the resolve() tooth could not hold. Both teeth are unchanged.
sub_problems.fills: a scratch launch whose instance link is a symlink under MSYS bash
